summary: First United Corp filed an 8-K to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.26 per share, declared by its Board, payable August 3, 2026, to holders of record July 20, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other transformative event is involved. The filing solely reports an ordinary dividend declaration consistent with past practice. The registrant is the issuer. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze. What to watch: any future change in dividend policy or earnings guidance.
